text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hup! Hah! Heeeh! Haaaa...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice Yukino Bijin looking a little
frustrated at
her dance lesson today.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
This is hopeless. I'm 'bout as graceful as
a rhino...
I don't look cool at all, do I?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What am I s'posed to do, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's not a bad idea! I'll watch a
ton of
people danc'n and see if I can't
absorb some of
their groove!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But where'm I s'posed to find a good
dancer to
watch?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Now you're talk'n! Actually, I just saw
this spiffy
place on Umastagram where
people go t'dance all
the time!
choice_data_list: Let's go check out a stylish place.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We made it to the disco deck! I heard
city kids
love danc'n at places like this.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's it!
Just look at how snazzy
everyone's dressed!

text_block_list.name: Woman with '80s Bangs
text_block_list.text:
Right on! I love how retro this place is!
The stage
by the pool is so groovy!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, heeeey! This place is totally
off the
chain! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hahah! Look, it's Maruzen! Ev'ryone's
got so much
spunk, and they look so
lively while they dance!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A-although... maybe this place is a bit too lively. I feel like I stick out like a sore thumb...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's right! I've got noth'n to worry
about with
you by m'side!
choice_data_list: As long as we're together, we'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's watch and learn! Then
once we're
ready, we'll get our boogies
on! Raaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hah! Heh! I gotta match the rhythm!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is that cutie over there Yukino?!

You go, girl! You're the bomb!

text_block_list.name: Woman with '80s Bangs
text_block_list.text: Squee! You're such a cutie-patootie! Hey, you should come dance with us!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A-are you talk'n to me?! Ha, hahaha...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'm gonna dance my heart out till
I'm hip
and jiggy with it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin mingles with all the cool
cats and
dances to the beat. It seems she
got something
out of this new
experience!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm pick'n up what you're putt'n down!
Let's learn
an UmaTok dance!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'm gonna search for some hip
dances!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... This one's the hashtag, right?
So I just
need t'put that, and then... Oh!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, this wasn't what I was pictur'n. Can
I filter it
by likes?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That did it! Thanks, Trainer! I didn't
know you
were such a tech wiz!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Geez, there's so many t'choose from.
What about
this one?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Latatata! ♪ Whoosh! ☆ And spin! ♪
Let's try it
together!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's Curren! Wow, she's cute as a
butt'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It says "#Currens10secondDanceLesson"
and
"#Dancewithme".

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Whoosh! ☆ I did it! What do you
think?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Two thumbs way up! A-plus-plus! ☆
Totes adorbs!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Jeepers creepers! Curren?! How long
have you
been here?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I just got here! I heard one of my
videos
playing, so I had to come take a
peek. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy you're trying out my
dances! ♪
Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I should be the one thank'n you! Without
you,
I'd've never been able t'learn such
an adorable,
fresh dance!
